overview_description.description: Boundo provides an AI-driven outbound sales platform that automates the core workflows of sales development representatives. The platform allows users to define their ideal customer profile and search across a large B2B lead database sourced from multiple third-party providers. It runs multichannel outbound campaigns over LinkedIn and email, generating and sending personalized messages, handling connection requests, and reacting to prospect activity. Boundo includes deliverability controls such as dispatch throttling, spam word filtering, and multi-step contact verification to protect sender reputation. An integrated intent-scoring system tracks engagement signals and ranks prospects to surface leads that are more likely to convert. The platform integrates with major CRM systems to sync contacts, log activity, and keep pipeline data current. Boundo is designed for B2B teams that want to systematize lead generation, outbound outreach, and qualification with minimal manual effort.
